categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of genetically modified animal models (mainly mice and rats) and related technical services. Main business segments include: (1) customized models tailored to customer specifications; (2) standardized models developed for market demand; (3) model breeding services; (4) pharmacological efficacy evaluation and phenotypic analysis services; (5) animal husbandry services; and (6) other model organism technical services including embryo cryopreservation and nematode research.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses four core technologies: (1) CRISPR/Cas system-based gene editing technology with proprietary enhancements (IERC and TERC systems); (2) ES cell targeting technology including serum-free culture systems and rapid cell line establishment; (3) gene expression regulation technology including transgenic expression switching systems and inducible gene control; and (4) assisted reproductive technology including ovulation induction and sex-directed control. These technologies enable precise genetic modification of model organisms to create disease models and humanized models for research and drug development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves two primary customer segments: (1) scientific research customers including universities, research institutes, and comprehensive hospitals conducting basic life science research and gene function studies; and (2) industrial customers including pharmaceutical companies, CRO/CXO companies, and biotech firms conducting drug discovery, preclinical evaluation, and safety assessment. The company reported serving over 900 scientific research customers and over 700 industrial customers in 2023.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major facilities in Shanghai (five bases: Banxia Road, Harley Road, Jinke Road, Jinshan Phase I, and Shangke Road), Guangdong (Zhongshan base), and Beijing (Beichen Road base). The company has established a US subsidiary (Shanghai Model Organisms Center USA LLC) in Texas to serve North American markets and is expanding into European markets including Germany, Japan, South Korea, and the UK.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the biomedical research supply chain. It sources raw materials (mice, rats, reagents, feed, bedding) from suppliers and produces genetically modified animal models and related services for downstream customers in pharmaceutical research, drug development, and life science research. The company also provides CRO services for preclinical drug evaluation, positioning it at the interface between basic research and drug development.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company maintains high R&D investment (21.89% of revenue in 2023) focused on: (1) optimizing gene editing technologies to improve efficiency and reduce off-target effects; (2) expanding standardized model libraries covering over 11,000 models including 760+ humanized models; (3) developing disease-specific models for oncology, immunology, neurology, metabolism, and rare diseases; (4) establishing humanized antibody screening platforms; and (5) enhancing pharmacological evaluation and phenotypic analysis capabilities. The company emphasizes precision medicine applications and personalized therapeutic development.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple streams: (1) product sales of customized and standardized genetically modified animal models with 3-30 day inspection periods before revenue recognition; (2) model breeding services billed monthly; (3) pharmacological efficacy evaluation and phenotypic analysis services; (4) animal husbandry services charged per cage per day; and (5) other technical services. Revenue is recognized upon customer confirmation or after inspection periods. The company uses direct sales channels with no distributor relationships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with both domestic and international competitors. Domestic competitors include Baiaosite, Yaokan Biology, and Saiyi Biology. International competitors include Jackson Laboratory (JAX), Charles River Laboratories, Taconic Biosciences, and Envigo. The company positions itself as a leading domestic provider with advantages in customized model construction speed, standardized model library size (11,000+ models), humanized model development (760+ models), and integrated CRO service capabilities. The company reports being among the top revenue-generating companies in China's genetically modified animal model industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of 366.55 million RMB (20.99% YoY growth) but reported a net loss of 20.58 million RMB (compared to 5.40 million RMB loss in 2022). Total assets were 1.998 billion RMB with shareholders' equity of 1.737 billion RMB. The company has grown from 275.27 million RMB revenue in 2021 to 366.55 million RMB in 2023. Operating cash flow was positive at 20.08 million RMB. The company is profitable on an operating basis but currently unprofitable due to high R&D and expansion costs.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) comprehensive one-stop service platform from gene-modified model construction to pharmacological evaluation; (2) extensive proprietary model library with 11,000+ standardized models and 760+ humanized models covering major drug targets; (3) advanced gene editing technologies with high success rates and rapid turnaround times; (4) large-scale SPF-certified animal facilities with AAALAC accreditation ensuring product quality; (5) experienced multidisciplinary research team with strong technical capabilities; and (6) deep customer relationships with leading pharmaceutical companies and research institutions. The company emphasizes precision medicine applications and personalized therapeutic support for innovative drug development.
